notes:
Summary: Codelens JetBridge is a developer tools startup building a JetBrains ecosystem plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that offers local-first code completions and search. They want a hybrid architecture: local incremental indexing for private repo symbols + optional Redwood-hosted models for heavier reasoning and fallbacks. Key asks: low-latency streaming completions, model/version pinning, and predictable unit economics for heavy usage across dev teams.

Notes (CRM style):
- Product: JetBrains plugin embedded UI, background incremental indexer that extracts symbols, docstrings, call graphs. Local vector store per workspace for privacy.
- Performance targets: first-token latency <100ms on dev machines for common completions; streaming token cadence ~20-40ms; end-to-end completion <300ms for short completions.
- Throughput: 100s concurrent devs in org; POC will simulate 50 active sessions. Cost-sensitive to per-token on hosted fallback; looking for batching and cache suggestions.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), audit logging, KMS for keys, and EU data residency for EU-based teams. On-prem option preferred for sensitive customers.
- Model requirements: ability to pin model versions per release channel; local/edge quantized models for some teams; fall back to Redwood-hosted curated models when local not available. Ability to hot-roll model variants during canary.
- Integration: plugin wants a streaming API that yields partial tokens for in-editor streaming; reason about JetBrains threading model & extension points. Concern: JetBrains Marketplace approval delays.
- POC ask: 2-week POC with 2 dev workstations indexing a medium-sized monorepo (~600k LOC); measure latency, memory footprint, index size, and token cost for hosted fallbacks.
- Quote from CTO: "We cannot leak IP — first-class local indexing is a must. If Redwood can make streaming completions feel native in IntelliJ, that's a huge win."
- Technical tradeoffs discussed: local quantized LLM vs. small remote model + prefix caching; hybrid search (symbol + vector) to improve precision; autoscaling of Dedicated pool for nightly indexing jobs.
- Linked artifacts: pricing + TCO deck, security questionnaire, SE notes from demo.
- Next immediate action: SE deep-dive on infrastructure (Marcus), provide infra checklist for POC and draft Dedicated vs Private TCO comparisons.

Short open items: legal redlines for local processing, EU residency SLA, exact acceptance criteria for indexing performance.
